Operations Analyst - Fleet and Depot Reporting

A regional transit and equipment services group seeks an operations analyst to
support fleet reporting, depot performance and parts planning across multiple
sites.

Responsibilities:
- Produce recurring operational reporting across depots and service branches
- Compare period-over-period performance and explain movement to operations managers
- Maintain and improve depot performance scorecards
- Reconcile high volumes of supplier and fuel invoices against internal records
- Identify repeat equipment failures and slow-moving stock from historical records
- Support quarterly stock level planning with usage history

Requirements:
- 5+ years in operations, fleet or inventory reporting
- Strong spreadsheet modelling and SQL
- Experience with invoice reconciliation at volume
- Ability to present findings to operations managers
- Associate degree or certificate in analytics, inventory control or a related field

This posting is synthetic test material. The employer is fictional.
